voice.name: Liam - Energetic, Social Media Creator
voice.why: The registrar sits behind the registry desk and says the same three words to every crew: name, flag, money. Dry, quick, a man who has heard every gang name before and is not impressed. Liam is a clear, articulate American male voice with an even pace, nothing like the gruff barkeeper, the French-accented clerks or the harbour master's rasp. Not used by any other speaker.

flag_same.text: Your gang already flies that flag.

flag_no_gang.text: You need a gang to fly a flag.

flag_not_leader.text: Only a gang leader can pick the gang flag.

greet.text: Registry. Crews and flags are my desk. What do you need?

found.text: Name, flag, and two hundred fifty dollars.

flags.text: A leader picks the flag at the wall. If another crew flies it and has someone around, it is taken.

picked.text: That is your flag. It is on the books.

taken.text: That one is taken. Another crew flies it. Pick a different one.

replies.found: I want to start a crew.
